significance: The foremost of the five pathis of the Ayyavazhi tradition, in Kanyakumari district. Its inner Palliyarai keeps objects held to have been used by Ayya Vaikundar, including a rattan cane and wooden sandals, and the Ayya Vaikunda Avataram festival draws followers from across the country.
story: Followers hold that Vaikundar performed austerities at this spot for six years and was afterwards interred within the temple.
